title: Edge: a single-invoice asset can still be expanded, and a customer with only no-vehicle work shows a single Parts Sales row
custom_preconds: 1. Customer A has an asset with exactly one invoice; customer B has ONLY no-vehicle (counter/parts sale) invoices in the current view (seed ZZAUTOTEST data).
custom_steps:
1. Expand customer A and click the chevron of the single-invoice asset.
2. Expand customer B and read its asset rows.
custom_expected:
1. The single-invoice asset expands and shows exactly one invoice detail row.
2. Customer B shows a single "Parts Sales" row and no vehicle rows.
